stability_protocol: 2 target grids x 2 fixed 15/15 split-half partitions; rel_k=clip(1-||N v_k||^2/||S v_k||^2,0,1); stable50=count(rel_k>=0.5)
band_rule: ceil(0.9411764705882353 * stable50) to floor(1.6 * stable50), clipped to rank 1..q
primary_endpoint: validation minimal rank within 0.005 R2 of the validation argmax lies inside preregistered rank band
secondary_endpoints: test R2 at preregistered center rank
test R2 at validation minimal-near-optimal rank
test_set_policy: test set is not used for capacity selection
